verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party Asana feature for creating or organizing shared docs, notes, or wikis alongside projects. The only related items are third-party integrations (Notion, Canva, Figma embeds), which are adjacent and earn no credit, and a community comment implying Asana's peers lack free-form notes and wikis.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
